learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain the goals, tasks, and structure of manufacturing companies.
Students can classify the effects of current trends and developments for manufacturing companies.
Students can reproduce logistics functions within and outside of companies.

Students are able to purposefully apply operational and strategic instruments for the analysis, planning, and calculation of production and logistics systems, thereby efficiently designing and controlling operational and inter-company processes.
Students can organizationally, technically, and capacitively design production-logistics subsystems with suitable methods and tools.
Students can model logistical problems and calculate and optimize them using suitable methods.
Students can distinguish common production concepts and order processing types and design them according to operational requirements.
Students can explain the challenges of Supply Chain Management and describe and apply measures for the sustainable design of supply chains.

syllabus_topics: Goals, tasks, and functions of manufacturing companies and associated logistics
Production concepts and order processing types
Organization of production and logistics systems
Concepts for increasing efficiency in industrial production
Fundamentals of production planning and control
Methods for analysis, calculation, and planning of production and logistics systems
Key figures and key figure systems
Introduction to the simulation of logistical systems
Introduction of digitization in production and logistics
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
